questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.
questions.explanation: Nevertheless is a formal linker meaning 'in spite of that', starting a new clause. Example: It was risky; nevertheless, they tried.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.
